name: @dawlabs/jira-cli-mcp
stderr:
Usage: jira [options] [command]

Jira Cloud + Confluence Cloud CLI & MCP server — full REST v3 surface, JQL, XML
export, identity map, Confluence spaces/pages/sync. Pure Jira + Confluence REST
API only.

Options:
  -v, --version                 print version
  --account <name>              use this credential profile from
                                ~/.jcm/accounts.json — must be allowed by the
                                project policy (env: JCM_ACCOUNT)
  --json                        print the structured result as JSON to stdout
  -q, --quiet                   suppress progress output on stderr
  --verbose                     show rate-limit waits, retries, and request URLs
                                on stderr
  --cwd <dir>                   run as if started in this directory (affects
                                workspace→project detection)
  --max-wait <ms>               max ms to wait for rate-limit budget before
                                failing (0 = never wait)
  --no-cache                    bypass the local read-through cache for this run
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  config                        manage the centralized ~/.jcm configuration
  doctor [options]              check Node version, ~/.jcm validity,
                                credentials, project files, and local state
  auth                          connection and rate-limit status
  myself                        show the authenticated Jira user
  search [options] <jql>        search issues with JQL (e.g. jira search
                                'project = DEMO AND status != Done ORDER BY
                                updated DESC')
  issue                         issue operations (get, create, update, move,
                                comment, …)
  user                          user lookup
  role                          the global project-role catalogue
  group                         user groups (site-wide)
  application                   application roles — product licenses and the
                                groups that hold them
  permission                    permissions: the catalogue, your effective set,
                                and grant schemes
  server                        server facts: version/build info and the
                                announcement banner
  project                       projects
  filter                        saved JQL filters
  meta                          discover fields, types, statuses, priorities
  status                        workflow statuses
  type                          issue types
  priority                      priorities
  workflow                      workflows (the status containers)
  screen                        screens (field layouts on issue views and
                                transitions)
  field                         the global field catalogue (system + custom)
  board                         scrum/kanban boards
  sprint                        sprints
  epic                          epics
  backlog [options]             backlog issues of a board
  identity                      identity map: jira username ↔ email ↔ github ↔
                                nickname ↔ …
  export                        export issues
  cache                         local one-way cache (hot entries + historical
                                snapshots)
  mcp                           Model Context Protocol server
  confluence                    Confluence Cloud spaces, pages, and markdown
                                sync (same ~/.jcm account; policy-guarded
                                writes)
  dashboard                     dashboards (read-only site reporting surfaces)
  mine [options]                my open tickets (add --or <name> for "me or
                                <name>")
  done [options]                completed by me (or --or <name>) within a window
  recent [options]              updated by/touched by me within a window
  blocked [options]             open tickets stuck — blocked by a link
